TA0030.title: Corporate Spies
TA0030.description: Also known as economic spies. Corporate spies are individuals or teams hired by a company or organization to obtain competitors' trade secrets, strategic plans, or other sensitive information to gain a business advantage. Corporate espionage may involve illegal means, violating laws and ethical norms, and is considered unfair competition and unethical business behavior.
